name: Toyo Automation Co., Ltd.
summary: Toyo Automation Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and trading of machinery and equipment in Asia, the United States, Europe, and Australia. The company offers single-axis and multi-axis linear actuators, servo and miniature cylinders, electric grippers, linear motor robots, nanometer-precision air bearing system and linear motor system, air bearing stage/alignment stage, desktop robots, clean room series, and controllers. It also provides support services. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.
